title: 同期不全な僕らのシンクロニシティ
author: ネオ・カナタ

en.title: Our Out-of-Sync Synchronicity
en.premise: I installed a mysterious app called 'HeartSync' that only allows you to chat with someone whose heart rate is perfectly synchronized with yours. There, I encountered a mysterious, sharp-tongued girl. But what if the classmate I clash with most in real life was actually my partner on the app? A rom-com about two incredibly awkward souls caught in the whirlwind of a digital connection.

zh.title: 同步失调的我们与共时性
zh.premise: 我安装了一个名为『HeartSync』的神秘应用，它只能让你与心跳同步的人进行聊天。在那里遇到的，是一位身份不明的毒舌少女。如果现实中相性最差的同学，其实就是应用里的聊天对象呢？这是一个被数字化连接所左右、两个笨拙不已的少年少女之间的爱情喜剧。
